skills.label: Identity administration
skills.task: Review and maintain users, groups, memberships, roles, authentication state, and authorized access paths.
skills.jobRelevance: Supports routine identity administration, access troubleshooting, change documentation, and escalation under established controls.
skills.scope: Professional access-support foundation plus personal Active Directory and Microsoft Entra lab evidence.
skills.limitations: Does not claim employer directory ownership, privileged production administration, or organization-wide policy enforcement.

skills.label: Windows Server administration
skills.task: Inspect Windows Server roles, services, storage, event summaries, domain state, and operational indicators.
skills.jobRelevance: Supports routine server checks, documented maintenance, fault isolation, and escalation-ready observations.
skills.limitations: Does not prove production ownership, high availability, enterprise patch management, or on-call responsibility.

skills.label: DNS, DHCP, and Group Policy
skills.task: Review name resolution, addressing, scope options, leases, policy objects, and bounded validation results.
skills.jobRelevance: Supports common directory-dependent infrastructure troubleshooting and configuration review.
skills.limitations: Does not demonstrate multi-site design, production change ownership, or organization-wide enforcement.

skills.label: Microsoft 365 and Entra administration
skills.task: Review tenant, identity, license, policy, device, application, sign-in, audit, and service configuration records.
skills.jobRelevance: Supports entry-level Microsoft 365 support, evidence gathering, configuration review, and escalation within assigned permissions.
skills.scope: Personal Microsoft 365 tenant and sanitized reviewed evidence.
skills.limitations: Does not claim production tenant ownership, Intune fleet administration, Exchange mail-flow ownership, or security assurance.

skills.label: Virtualization operations
skills.task: Review Proxmox hosts, virtual machines, bridges, storage, guest integration, and bounded lifecycle operations.
skills.jobRelevance: Supports inventory, routine VM checks, controlled maintenance, and evidence-based escalation.
skills.limitations: Does not prove enterprise virtualization ownership, clustered availability, or production capacity planning.

skills.label: Backup and restore operations
skills.task: Review scheduled scope, archives, storage, integrity records, network isolation, controlled restore tests, and cleanup.
skills.jobRelevance: Supports routine backup verification and carefully bounded restore procedures under an approved runbook.
skills.scope: Personal nonproduction lab with scoped isolated restore evidence.
skills.limitations: A successful isolated restore does not prove full disaster recovery, application recovery, recurring assurance, RTO, or RPO.

skills.label: Linux administration
skills.task: Review Linux services, networking, DNS, time, logging, updates, guest integration, and directory integration.
skills.jobRelevance: Supports routine Linux checks, service troubleshooting, documentation, and escalation.
skills.limitations: Does not claim production Linux fleet ownership, high availability, or broad platform engineering experience.

skills.label: Networking and firewall support
skills.task: Inspect routes, VLAN and subnet context, DNS responses, TCP reachability, pfSense state, and documented policy expectations.
skills.jobRelevance: Supports first-line infrastructure path analysis and evidence-rich escalation.
skills.scope: Documented personal-lab network paths and bounded connectivity checks.
skills.limitations: Timeouts are not converted into outage findings, and the evidence does not prove enterprise network ownership or security assurance.

skills.label: PowerShell automation
skills.task: Run repeatable inventory, validation, structured export, sanitization, integrity, and repository-quality workflows.
skills.jobRelevance: Supports consistent checks, reduced manual variation, reviewable output, and safer escalation artifacts.
skills.scope: Repository and personal-lab automation with reviewable scripts and outputs.
skills.limitations: Repository automation does not imply unattended production change authority or organization-wide operational impact.

skills.label: Troubleshooting and RCA
skills.task: Clarify symptoms, bound scope, test hypotheses, record observations, distinguish results from gaps, and identify next actions.
skills.jobRelevance: Connects professional Service Desk practice to infrastructure support and escalation discipline.
skills.scope: Professional support foundation plus sanitized portfolio and personal-lab examples.
skills.limitations: Public lab records do not disclose employer or client systems and do not convert inconclusive checks into failures.

skills.label: Technical documentation
skills.task: Create tickets, runbooks, inventories, validation reports, manifests, change records, and explicit limitation statements.
skills.jobRelevance: Supports repeatability, peer review, clean handoffs, auditability, and useful escalation.
skills.scope: Professional documentation foundation plus public sanitized repository artifacts.
skills.limitations: A documented configuration proves captured and reviewed state only, not universal correctness or current production operation.

skills.label: Technical escalation
skills.task: Provide confirmed observations, commands, recorded sequence, scope, limitations, impact context, and the next required decision.
skills.jobRelevance: Helps senior administrators act on a well-bounded problem without repeating basic discovery.
skills.scope: Professional support practice and repository-backed evidence discipline.
skills.limitations: Does not imply independent authority for high-risk production changes or incident command.

developmentAreas: Measured recovery objectives and recurring restore assurance
